text:
Jon H (Finance): Heads up — reseller CloudChannel reported duplicate line items on the March Azure Marketplace invoice. They estimate ~$72k in duplicate charges tied to a SKU mapping change we rolled Mar 1.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Can you paste an example from their file? We need invoice lines + meter IDs to validate.

Jon H (Finance): Partner provided this CSV excerpt: 
```
invoice_line_id,sku,meter_id,usage,charge
L-192837,sku-redwood-v1,98765,120000,21454.32
L-192838,sku-redwood-v1-alt,98765,120000,21454.32
L-192839,sku-redwood-emb,54321,40000,29432.36
```
They say meter_id 98765 was double-counted under two SKUs after our mapping update.

Maya K (Sales): Confirming we pushed a SKU->meter mapping tweak on Mar 1 to align with Azure's rename. I asked EngOps if the change propagated to channel/reseller path but didn't get a confirmation. Partner opened ticket this morning.

Liam B (Billing Ops): If payout hasn't processed we can intercept. @BillingBot check payout status for CloudChannel Ltd (partner_id CC-9382).

BillingBot: Payout status: scheduled payout 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z. Status: pending (not processed). No holds.

Jon H (Finance): Proposed workflow: 1) get signed partner acknowledgement, 2) issue manual credit for the duplicate amount, memo "AZ-MP-2026-03-CREDIT", 3) update GL and reduce payout before settlement, 4) post-mortem to avoid recurrence.

Priya R (Head of Revenue): I approve the manual credit up to $75k contingent on legal sign-off and partner acceptance in writing. Please capture the acceptance in our contract system.

Sofia (Legal): Draft amendment clause: "Partner accepts a one-time retroactive correction limited to the billing cycle ending 2026-03-17 related to the SKU mapping error. Acceptance waives claims for the same issue for the corrected period. This correction does not set precedent for charges older than 60 days prior to notice." If acceptable I'll send to partner for signature.

Maya K (Sales): I'll send the amendment + credit confirmation to CloudChannel now and ask for signed acceptance by EOD. Also recommending adding a SKU mapping propagation check to the reseller rollout checklist.

Liam B (Billing Ops): GL impact — proposed coding: Debit Revenue 4205-REV-CR / Credit AP - Partner 2202 with memo AZ-MP-2026-03-CREDIT. I'll hold action until we have the signed doc.

BillingBot: Will place temporary payout hold when Finance marks adjustment ready. Please upload signed amendment to partner portal and ping me.

Maya K (Sales): Partner signed and returned at 2026-03-20T09:42:00Z. Uploaded to contract repo and partner portal. Email confirmation sent.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Running the manual adjustment now. Posting journal entry and reducing scheduled payout by $72,341. Memo entered.

Jon H (Finance): Received posting confirmation. Marking ticket resolved in billing queue. Let's schedule a 30-min post-mortem with EngOps + Sales to add rollout verification and a minimal automated test.

Sofia (Legal): Amendment archived in contract repo. Closing legal side.

BillingBot: Payout updated to reflect credit. No further action pending.

Maya K (Sales): Loop closed with CloudChannel. They appreciate the quick fix. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
